children: U.S. stock index futures trimmed gains on Friday as investors weighed the consumer inflation report for August.
A Labor Department report showed the Consumer Price Index rose 3.4% on an annual basis last month, in line with estimates. On a monthly basis, it rose 0.4%, also matching expectations.

Excluding volatile food and energy components, core CPI increased 2.4% annually in August, same as what economists had expected. It stood at 0.3% on a monthly basis, compared with expectations of a 0.2% rise.
